AspectRatio.description:
How a path's `viewBox` fills its box, as SVG's `preserveAspectRatio`: whole and centred (`"xMidYMid meet"`, the
default), or stretched to it (`"none"`).

Blend.description:
How a layer mixes with what is under it. Normal, multiply, screen and add are blend states; overlay reads the
frame below, like an adjustment layer.

Cone.description: Where particles head: `angle` degrees (0 is right, −90 up), spread over `spread` degrees.

Count.description: The counter: the text shows a number going from `from` to `to`, starting `at` seconds for `dur` seconds.

FillRule.description: Which parts of a path are inside, as SVG's `fill-rule`.

Fit.description: `shrink`: down to 50 %, then wrap within `wrap`, then clip to the box; `clip`: clip to the box.

Flag.description: On or off, or `"$key"`, an on/off setting.

oneOf.description: Ships with Klipolo (`assets/fonts`).
Google Fonts, downloaded on the person's pick: `version` is the catalogue's (`v31`).
On this computer only.

GeneratorFill.description: A generator contribution drawn inside the shape, with its settings (values or `"$key"` bindings).

Gradient.description: Exactly one of `linear` and `radial`, and 2–16 `stops` in order.

angle.description: Degrees the gradient turns about the box's centre.

linear.description: From `[x0, y0]` to `[x1, y1]`: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]`, fractions of the node's box.

offset.description: Slides every stop along the gradient (a shimmer animates it).

radial.description: Centre and radius: `[cx, cy, r]`, fractions of the node's box.

MaskRef.description: A group shows only where another node (`"#id"`) is opaque (`alpha`) or bright (`luma`), or the reverse.

Modifier.description: Movement added to a property, deterministic and seeded: `{"type": "wiggle", "freq": 2, "amp": 5}`.

oneOf.description: Smooth noise, `freq` times a second, up to `amp`.
A sine wave, fading by `decay` a second.
Keeps moving at `speed` a second.

MotionPath.description:
Moves the node along a path as `progress` goes from 0 to 1, its origin on the path: SVG `d` fitted into the
parent's box as a `path` node's is (its `viewBox`, else the path's own bounds, `xMidYMid meet` unless `none`), or
`"#id"` of a `path` node, which then lends its `d`, `viewBox` and box.

autoRotate.description: Turns the node to face along the path.

viewBox.description: `[x, y, width, height]` of the path's coordinates that fill the parent's box.

Node.description:
One drawn thing (or a group of them), inside its `box`: `[x, y, w, h]`, fractions of its parent's box (the
layer's at the top); the whole box when left out.

class.description: Space-separated names; tweens select them as `.name`.

clip.description: `inset(t r b l round r)` or `circle(r at x y)`.

count.description: Counts from one number to another (the value animator).

d.description: SVG path data, in the path's own units: its `viewBox` (else its own bounds) fills the node's box.

dash.description:
Dash and gap lengths in 1080p pixels (a `path`'s in its stroke's units), 1 to 4 of them (an odd list repeats,
as in SVG). Dashes are cut square; the line's caps are its ends'.

drag.description: How fast particles slow down, per second.

emoji.description: Drawn by the system's emoji face.

gap.description: How far each instance moves from the one before: `[dx, dy]`.

gravity.description: 1080p pixels a second, a second (down is positive).

holds.description: Text that changes at given times ("SUBSCRIBE" → "SUBSCRIBED").

id.description: Unique in the scene; tweens select it as `#id`.

innerRadius.description: A star's inner points, as a fraction of its outer radius.

mask.description: Groups: another node's alpha or luma.

modifiers.description: Per property name: a wiggle, an oscillation or a marquee added to it.

origin.description: What it scales and turns about, in its own box: `"50% 0%"`, `"center"`, `[0.5, 1]`.

points.description: A polyline's points: a `"$table"` setting or `[[x, y], …]` fractions of the box.

preserveAspectRatio.description: `"xMidYMid meet"` (the default: whole and centred) or `"none"` (stretched to the box).

rotateX.description: Groups: a 3D tilt in degrees, seen through `perspective` (1080p pixels).

rows.description: One instance per row of a table setting: `"$data"`.

sides.description: A polygon's sides or a star's points, 3–64.

sizeOverLife.description: Scale factors spread evenly over each particle's life, at most 8.

spans.description: Parts with their own look, instead of `text`.

split.description: Animates characters, words or lines one by one (with `stagger`).

src.description: The name of an SVG in the request's `svgs`.

strokeScale.description: False: a path's stroke and dashes are 1080p pixels, whatever the path's size.

strokeWidth.description: 1080p pixels; a `path`'s are in its own units and scale with it, as in SVG, unless `strokeScale` is false.

tint.description: A colour laid over what is under the layer (with `blur` blurring it).

trim.description: Draws only part of the stroke (draw-on).

viewBox.description: A path's `[x, y, width, height]` that fills its box; its gradients are fractions of it.

wrap.description: The width lines wrap at, a fraction of the box or `"640px"`.

x.description: Moves the node: a fraction of its parent's box, `"50%"`, or `"22px"`.

oneOf.description: A rectangle, `radius` rounding its corners.
`sides` points, `innerRadius` deep.
A regular polygon of `sides` sides.
From the box's top left to its bottom right.
SVG path data (`d`).
`points`, from a table setting or written out, optionally `smooth`.
An image setting (`asset`) or an emoji.
Submissions only: an SVG the worker turns into `path` nodes before storing the scene.
Its children `times` times, or once per row of a table setting (`rows`).
Particles: a seeded burst or rate of its `child`.
Blurs or tints what is under the layer, inside its box.

NumRange.description: One number, or a `[min, max]` each particle picks from.

Origin.description: `[x, y]` (fractions, `"50%"` or `"22px"`), or CSS words: `"50% 0%"`, `"center"`, `"left top"`.

Outline.description: A line around each glyph, in 1080p pixels.

Paint.description:
A colour (`#RGB`, `#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA`, `rgb()`, `rgba()`) or a `"$key"` colour setting; a gradient; or a
generator drawn inside the shape.

ParamSpec.description:
One declared parameter. JSON: `{"key":"radius","label":"Radius","type":"float","min":0,"max":64,"default":12,…}`,
the same shape the plugin manifest uses.

oneOf.description: `#RRGGBB`, or `#RRGGBBAA` when `alpha`.
Degrees from −360 to 360; shaders receive radians.
One of the project's assets, by id (no default).
A `FontRef`, resolved through the one font resolver (bundled, then a downloaded Google family, then installed).

Rows of a label and `columns.len()` numbers (at most `MAX_TABLE_COLUMNS`), at most `max_rows` of them (and
`MAX_TABLE_ROWS`): a chart's bars, a list's lines.

key.description: The stored key; for shader contributions also the WGSL field name.

visibleWhen.description:
When the setting applies; always when absent. Purely presentational: the UI hides the setting otherwise,
and its stored value stays (and stays valid) for when it applies again.

ParamUnit.description: How a number reads in the UI.

oneOf.description: Pixels at a 1080-pixel shorter side; shaders multiply by `kl.px`.

anyOf.description: Colours (`#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA`), choices, texts and asset ids.

A font setting's face: a `FontRef` (`{"family": …, "source": {"type": …}}`), never read as a point. A
bare family name is the tools' shorthand, resolved before it reaches the model.
A table setting's rows. Last, so strings, numbers and points read as before.

ParamValue.description: A stored parameter value; its [`ParamSpec`] says what it means.

PointN.description: A point in 0 to 1 coordinates of the layer (or the canvas), from the top left.

Points.description: A polyline's points: `"$key"`, a table setting (one point a row), or `[[x, y], …]`.

Radius.description: One radius for every corner, or `[top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left]`, in 1080p pixels.

Reveal.description: The typewriter: the text appears by characters or words from `at` over `dur` seconds.

SceneFont.description:
A text node's font: a `FontRef`'s JSON (`{"family": "Montserrat", "source": {"type": "google", "version": "v31"}}`)
with an optional `weight` and `italic` beside it, which win over the node's own; or a bare family name, the
shorthand, kept as written and resolved by the fonts' `resolve_family` when drawn; or `"$key"`, a font setting.

SceneKey.description: One key of an animated property: at `t` seconds the value is `v`, eased in from the key before.

Scramble.description: Random characters (from `chars`) settling into the text from `at` over `dur` seconds.

Segments.description: Scene times in `[0, in]` play from the layer's start and those in `[duration − out, duration]` up to its end.

Selectors.description: `"#id"`, `".class"` or a node type (`"text"`), or a list of them.

Shadow.description: A drop shadow: offset, blur and spread in 1080p pixels, and a colour.

Span.description: Part of a text with its own look; a `background` makes a marker highlight or a pill.

StaggerArg.description:
Seconds between targets (or split units), or the whole spread: `0.05` or
`{"each": 0.05, "from": "center"}` or `{"amount": 0.6, "from": "random", "seed": 7}`.

TableRow.description: One row of a table setting: a label and one number per column.

Trim.description: Fractions of the stroke's length: it draws from `start` to `end`, both moved along by `offset`.

Tween.description:
One GSAP-shaped tween: exactly one of `to`, `from`, `fromTo` (with `start`) or `set`, the nodes it animates, when
(`at`), how long (`dur`) and how (`ease`), and the property values (everything else, `vars`).

at.description:
Seconds, `"<"` (the previous tween's start), `">"` (its end), `"+=s"` and `"-=s"` (from the timeline's end),
a label defined earlier, `"out"` (the exit segment) or `"out+s"`; the timeline's end when left out.

label.description: Names this tween's start for later `at`s.

repeat.description: Extra runs; −1 repeats until the scene ends.

start.description: `fromTo`'s start values; `vars` are its end values.

Val.description: A number, or a string: a colour, a `"$binding"`, `"50%"`, `"22px"`, a clip, an origin or a text.

VisibleWhen.description:
A setting applies only while the choice setting `key` of the same contribution has one of the values `in`.
JSON: `{"key":"shape","in":["rounded","frame"]}`. `ContribDef::check_conditions` checks it when the definition
loads.

nodes.description: Drawn in order, later on top; at most 200 counting children.

params.description: At most 16: text, colour, number, choice, on/off, font, image and table settings.

scene.description: Always 1 (`scene@1`); a larger number was made for a newer Klipolo.

segments.description: The entrance and exit: with them the hold between stretches to the layer's length.
